name: helpdesk-schema-repair
description: LU 2.4 Assignment: Fix the broken Helpdesk PostgreSQL schema to match the ER diagram

scripts.db:reset: psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS helpdesk_test;" && psql -U postgres -h localhost -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE helpdesk_test;" && psql -U postgres -h localhost -d helpdesk_test -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgtap;" && psql -U postgres -h localhost -d helpdesk_test -f migrations/001_initial_schema.sql
